newsitem.title: USA: AES Corp says prices stock, securities.
newsitem.headline: AES Corp says prices stock, securities.

text.p: AES Corp said Tuesday it priced its combined public offering of common shares and term convertible securities on March 24.
The offering of 2.55 million common share was priced at $58.625 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of about $150 million, the company said in a statement.

The convertible securities, known as TECONS, were prices to yield 5-3/8 percent, with a 23.5 percent conversion premium. Aggregate gross proceeds of these securities are about $250 million, the Arlington, Va.,-based company said.
TECONS will be issued by AES Trust I, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the company.
The lead underwriter for both offerings is J.P. Morgan.
Net proceeds of the combined offerings are expected to be about $387 million.

AES is a global power company that currently owns or has an interest in 34 power facilities totalling over 11,000 megawatts in the United States, Argentina, Brazil, Pakistan, Hungary, Kazakstan, China and the United Kingdom.
